title: data/maps/dublin.json is now a sim input (drives the district director) but no hash binds its bytes into the T1/replay gate — only map identity is pinned
evidence: core/catalog.odin:1487 `catalogs_hash_sources :: proc(src: ^Catalog_Sources) -> u64 {` ... folds ONLY: `fold(&h, src.node_types)` / `fold(&h, src.pipe_tiers)` / `fold(&h, src.packet_types)` / `fold(&h, src.demand)` / `fold(&h, src.eras)` / `fold(&h, src.crises)` / `fold(&h, src.balance)` — no map source. harness/manifest.odin Manifest struct carries only `version: i64, demo: string, seed: u64, logic_hz: i64, catalog_hash: u64, ticks: i64` (no map hash). harness/run.odin:830 `if header.catalog_hash != cat.hash {` is the sole catalog binding on replay. Yet core/growth.odin (board branch) derives spawns from the board: `d := map_district_assign(board, t.node_pos[i])` + `growth_district_live_count(board, t, d) >= growth_district_cap(board, cat, d)`. The spec's claim (_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-v2-dublin-spawn-director.md §1.6): "the map_source byte already pins the map input in the T1 hash (absent-when-procedural)" — map_source pins WHICH map, not its bytes.
detail: Since this PR the dublin.json bytes drive spawns, but catalog_hash folds only the 7 catalog files. A dublin.json edit replays old dublin_board logs/T1s with a PASSING header check; rejection happens only if an in-window spawn shifts — otherwise a silent pass, against manifest.odin's "DEFINED re-bless, never a silent shift (ODN-11)". Stage-2 jobs 2/3 will edit the map.
recommended_fix: Fold the dublin.json bytes into catalog_hash (or add a map_hash field to the T1/log headers bound by run.odin like logic_hz) so any map edit is a defined re-bless.
